thermal_proxy: Sum remaining particle mass * (particle surface temperature C -20C), divided by initial total particle mass. Kelvin-equivalent surface-heating index; NOT stored energy.
no_true_stored_energy: No internal temperature profile or per-frame component heat capacity/composition in saved summaries. Surface TMP_F is not volume-mean material temperature. Gas density/composition also absent.
spatial_candidate: Gas temperature-excess centroid with separate strength/presence; source-inclusive and not directional heat transfer. Not crown-anchored; cannot replace an energy scalar.
stage3_rule: First evaluate scalar controlled comparison. Audit spatial candidate interpretation now; only train spatial extension if validation evidence shows scalar insufficient and identifiable spatial candidate with reproducible labels. Do not select additions from test results.
